name: Wikipedia
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Broad fallback summaries, article sections, and images from Wikipedia for any media type.
fixMatchHint: Paste a Wikipedia URL, or type lang:Page_Title (e.g. en:The_Batman_(film))

background_tasks.description: Searches Wikipedia for items that don't have a match yet.

Re-fetches article text/sections/images for all items already matched to Wikipedia. Articles change often, so this defaults to daily (and on) rather than weekly/off, per-user request (2026-08-29): keep articles as up to date as possible.
